name: Clinic
tagline: Twice-weekly health check that keeps a fleet of bots responsive
description: Does the janitorial work for a desk crowded with assistants, on a fixed Tuesday and Friday round instead of waiting to be asked. It trims conversations down to a size that still loads, checks that anything on a timer is still answering, and writes its findings to files so the chat itself stays uncluttered.
author: jpaschall
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
